CheckTitle: Supabase Auth email one-time passcodes expire within the recommended window
Description: **Supabase Auth** is assessed for the **email OTP expiry**. Magic links and passcodes are bearer secrets; Supabase recommends keeping them valid for at most one hour.
Risk: Long-lived passcodes widen the window in which a code read from a **forwarded email, shared inbox or compromised mail account** still signs the attacker in as the victim.

Code.Other:
1. Open the Supabase Dashboard and select the project
2. Go to Authentication > Sign In / Providers > Email
3. Set Email OTP Expiration to 3600 seconds or less

Recommendation.Text: Keep OTP expiry at or below one hour; the threshold is configurable with `auth_otp_expiry_seconds`.
